rules.title: A value has one home
rules.text: A default stated twice can disagree with itself. The server owns its own defaults, the caller owns the flags, and a constant that repeats either is a second source of truth the pipeline cannot see. What makes it visible in a review is the second statement being on screen.

judgement.question: Does the excerpt show this value defined more than once — another constant carrying the same value, a literal repeated for the same purpose — so that only one of them can be changed in step?

criteria.true: the same value is defined twice within view (two constants, or a constant and a literal used for the same purpose), with nothing keeping the two in step
criteria.false: the value is defined once in view, or the repetition is a different quantity that happens to share the number
